environment.description: Same application deployed behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in AWS VPC subnet 10.200.0.0/16. The NLB target group has a security group with inbound rules allowing TCP/443 only from CIDR blocks 10.100.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress) and 10.150.0.0/24 (CI/CD runner subnet). The VPC has no internet gateway attached to the subnet hosting the NLB, and no NAT gateway routes exist for inbound traffic. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero packets from non-RFC1918 sources. Additionally, the EKS cluster's aws-auth ConfigMap restricts kubectl access to a specific IAM role, and the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem. The NLB listener does not perform TLS termination - it passes through to the pod's TLS context.
